messages:
jess: Hey team, Zephyr Labs is hitting repeated 500s from our hosted endpoint and they see very high tail latency. They provided a request id: r-9c3f2a. Happening ~2025-04-08T17:03Z. Can we collect repro logs + node GPU metrics?

mike: thanks — can you paste a minimal curl that reproduces for them and any pod name if it's Dedicated? also want the exact time window.

jess: curl they used (redacted token):
```
curl -v -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED' \ 
  -H 'X-Request-Id: r-9c3f2a' \ 
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \ 
  https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \ 
  -d '{"model":"redwood-3b","input":"summarize: test"}'
```
They say request consistently times out ~12s then 500. Tenant is on dedicated pool; pod I see in our dashboard: `zephyr-api-5f8d9` on node `gpu-node-43`. Time window ~ 17:00-17:10 UTC.

anya: oncall here, I'll request a debug bundle from the node. mike — do you want pod logs, dmesg and nvidia-smi snapshot?

mike: yes. steps for Zephyr support engineer (short):
1) kubectl -n zephyr logs zephyr-api-5f8d9 -c inference --since=20m > /tmp/zephyr-pod.log
2) kubectl -n zephyr exec -it zephyr-api-5f8d9 -c inference -- /bin/sh -c 'cat /proc/1/environ' > /tmp/env.txt
3) ssh root@gpu-node-43 and run: 
   - sudo journalctl -u kubelet --since '30 minutes ago' > /tmp/kubelet.log
   - sudo dmesg --ctime | grep -i xid > /tmp/dmesg_xid.log || true
   - sudo /usr/bin/nvidia-smi --query-gpu=index,utilization.gpu,temperature.gpu,driver_version --format=csv > /tmp/nvidia-smi.csv
4) collect host metrics: /opt/redwood/bin/collect_host_metrics --interval 60 --duration 600 --out /tmp/host-metrics.json
5) run our collector: /opt/redwood/bin/collect_debug_bundle --tenant zephyr --request r-9c3f2a --out /tmp/zephyr-1758882222.tar.gz
6) aws s3 cp /tmp/zephyr-1758882222.tar.gz s3://redwood-debug-bundles/zephyr/1758882222.tar.gz --acl private

luca: also check runtime logs for kv-cache pressure and any kernel OOM events. In the pod logs look for lines with `KV_CACHE` and `fallback to cpu` or `quantize` failures.

jess: copying those instructions to Zephyr and asking them to run. I'll also ask for the raw curl response + headers when it 500s.

ops-bot: Support ticket created: SUP-2025-8743 for tenant Zephyr Labs — assigned to support oncall.

anya: quick note — if they can't SSH the node (private DC), ask them to upload the following collected files from the container: /var/log/redwood/inference.log, /tmp/host-metrics.json, /tmp/nvidia-smi.csv and the output of `cat /proc/driver/nvidia/version` to the S3 path above. I'll watch the upload.

mike: when they upload, share the S3 presigned URL here and I'll run through the bundle. If we see Xid messages in dmesg_XID that's priority for infra and kernel team.

jess: Zephyr replied with upload started, presign: https://s3.eu.redwood/debug/zephyr/1758882222.tar.gz?X-EXAMPLE

mike: grabbing now. quick grep of the pod log shows repeated: `WARN inference: tokenization stalled after 8s` and then `ERROR http: handler: 500 internal server error request_id=r-9c3f2a`. pulling the node dmesg next.

luca: if node shows high GPU memory fragmentation or repeated context resets (`Xid`), escalate to eng-runtime. Otherwise we should look at batching backlog around the timestamp; ask them for concurrent QPS and if they had any model rollouts.

jess: final note to Zephyr: please include the curl output with `-i` (headers) and the pod env var `REDWOOD_MODEL_VERSION`. They replied with model version `redwood-3b-v1.2.0`.

mike: got it. leaving this thread open — I'll post findings after I finish the bundle inspection.

anya: tagging eng-runtime: @luca for visibility.

(Operations) ops-bot: Debug bundle s3 upload completed: s3://redwood-debug-bundles/zephyr/1758882222.tar.gz
